text: Life Insurance Corporation Of India held 112,606,132 shares (11.49%) of Tech Mahindra Limited as of 31 December 2025.
short: LIC holds about 11.5% of Tech Mahindra.

source.name: Tech Mahindra — Shareholding pattern for Q3 FY 2025-26 (quarter ended 31 December 2025)
source.note: Public-shareholder table, section B1(e) 'Insurance Companies', disclosure of shareholders holding 1% or more; the figure after the name is the share count and percentage of total shares. LIC's promoter is the President of India (96.50%, per LIC's own pattern as on 1 June 2026).
